subject: Pen-test artifacts escrow & EU cross-border data checklist
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@assureworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pen-test artifacts escrow & EU cross-border data checklist

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As we move toward the pen-test engagement for the AssureWorks connector, legal and security have asked us to formalize an artifacts escrow and EU cross-border handling plan ahead of the on-site/remote testing window.

Quick summary of what we need to align on:
- A short escrow MSA clause covering custody and access for test artifacts (logs, packet captures, PII redacted traces).
- Retention windows for artifact storage and a secure deletion confirmation.
- A clear data flow diagram showing where artifact copies will live during the engagement (we prefer EU-resident storage for EU customers).
- Proof/assurance of chain-of-custody (checksums, access logs) and an SFTP or signed URL flow we can operate.

I attached a draft escrow MSA (redwood_escrow_msa_draft_v1.pdf) and our current data-flow diagram (redwood_data_flow_diagram.png) to jumpstart the conversation. Can you confirm whether AssureWorks has an existing artifact-escrow process and, if so, share your standard checklist? If not, would you be open to our proposed retention windows below?

Proposed retention (Redwood preference):
- Working artifacts during engagement: store in EU region; 30 days after delivery for analysis.
- Post-project escrow copy: 90-day retention, with deletion certificate upon request.

If this looks reasonable, can we set a 30-minute sync this afternoon (I pasted a tentative calendar link) to finalize the checklist and handoff?

Thanks,

--
Michael Grant
Director, Partner Security Programs
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment(s): redwood_escrow_msa_draft_v1.pdf (PDF), redwood_data_flow_diagram.png (PNG)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@assureworks.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen-test artifacts escrow & EU cross-border data checklist

Hi Michael —

Appreciate the context and the materials. We do have an artifacts escrow flow we can offer for integrations; I've attached our standard checklist (assureworks_artifact_checklist_v2.xlsx) and a short note on custody procedures. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) For EU-resident storage, we can provision a dedicated S3 bucket in eu-west-1 and enable server-side encryption + restricted access policies (we'll provide temporary IAM roles scoped to the engagement).
2) Chain-of-custody: we attach SHA256 checksums to each artifact and publish an access audit log daily to both parties; retention of audit logs is 180 days by default but we can scope that down for this engagement to 90 days if needed.
3) Deletion/certification: we can provide a signed deletion certificate after artifacts are purged.

Questions:
- Does Redwood require artifacts to be redacted to remove any production PII before transfer, or is redaction handled post-transfer in the escrow environment?
- Is the 90-day post-project escrow copy acceptable, or do you prefer a shorter window (we can do 60 days with a signed confirmation).

If you like, Priyom and I can run through the checklist line-by-line in the sync; I'm available at 15:30 or 16:00 PT.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Partnerships
AssureWorks
laura.bennett@assureworks.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachment(s): assureworks_artifact_checklist_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Pen-test artifacts escrow & EU cross-border data checklist

Thanks Michael / Laura — adding a few technical constraints from the infra side so the team can scope the handoff cleanly:

- Preferred transfer mechanism: pre-signed S3 URLs to the eu-west-1 bucket with expiry of 24 hours. We prefer not to use SFTP unless necessary because it complicates automation for ingestion.
- Artifact naming convention: <customer>_<engagement>_<yyyymmdd>_<artifact-type>. We need this to automatically tag and index artifacts for later traceability.
- Redaction: Redwood will perform an initial PII redaction pass before packaging artifacts for escrow. For the artifacts that can't be redacted (packet captures that must remain raw), we'll encrypt at rest with a customer-specific KMS key and share decryption access only with AssureWorks under a split-key process.
- Access logs: we require daily signed audit log exports (JSON) with at least the fields: actor, action, artifact_id, timestamp, checksum.

One additional ask from Compliance (Neha): can we add a clause that any third-party subprocessors AssureWorks uses for escrow (e.g., cloud provider backups) must be disclosed and approved in writing prior to transfer?

If we align on these points I can update the MSA draft and mark the escrow annex as final. Laura — you can tell me which items on your checklist map to these bullets and we’ll reconcile.

-Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Sr. Security Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Laura / Priyom — great alignment. Quick replies and next steps: 

- Redaction: Redwood will perform initial PII redaction where feasible. For any artifacts that must remain raw for the test, we'll use the KMS + split-key approach Priyom outlined.
- Retention: 60-day post-project escrow copy is acceptable to us; please update the checklist to reflect 60 days and include the signed deletion certificate process.
- Subprocessors: AssureWorks must disclose any subprocessors used for storage/backup prior to transfer; please add that to the annex.

Next steps: Priyom will incorporate the infra bullets into the MSA annex and I'll circulate an updated PDF. Laura — can you confirm availability for a 30-min sync at 16:30 PT today? I've tentatively added a calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-30min-sync

If we get agreement on the call we can finalize the annex and have legal sign-off in 48 hours.

Thanks,
